{
  "tests": [
    {
      "name": "greets a name", "polarity": "success", "covers": "happy",
      "given": "\"Ada\"",
      "expect": "Hello, Ada! and a nil error"
    },
    {
      "name": "trims the name", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:name",
      "given": "\"  Ada  \"",
      "expect": "Hello, Ada! and a nil error"
    },
    {
      "name": "refuses an empty name", "polarity": "negative", "covers": "error:1",
      "given": "\"   \"",
      "expect": "an empty string and a *NameError"
    }
  ],
  "test_file": "package greet\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestGreet(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := []struct {\n\t\tname    string\n\t\tin      string\n\t\twant    string\n\t\twantErr bool\n\t}{\n\t\t{\"greets a name\", \"Ada\", \"Hello, Ada!\", false},\n\t\t{\"trims the name\", \"  Ada  \", \"Hello, Ada!\", false},\n\t\t{\"refuses an empty name\", \"   \", \"\", true},\n\t}\n\tfor _, c := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tgot, err := Greet(c.in)\n\t\t\tif (err != nil) != c.wantErr {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Greet(%q) error = %v, wantErr %v\", c.in, err, c.wantErr)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif got != c.want {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Greet(%q) = %q, want %q\", c.in, got, c.want)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif c.wantErr {\n\t\t\t\tif _, ok := err.(*NameError); !ok {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Greet(%q) error is %T, want *NameError\", c.in, err)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n"
}
